mapper.select: SELECT b.BOOK_ID, b.ACCOUNT_CODE, a.ACCOUNT_NAME, b.PERIOD, b.CURRENCY_CODE, b.BEGINNING_DEBIT, b.BEGINNING_CREDIT, b.PERIOD_DEBIT, b.PERIOD_CREDIT, b.ENDING_DEBIT, b.ENDING_CREDIT, b.UPDATE_TIME FROM TBL_ACCOUNT_BALANCE b LEFT JOIN TBL_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT a ON b.ACCOUNT_CODE = a.ACCOUNT_CODE AND b.BOOK_ID = a.BOOK_ID WHERE b.BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND b.ACCOUNT_CODE = #{accountCode} AND b.PERIOD = #{period} AND b.CURRENCY_CODE = #{currencyCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_ACCOUNT_BALANCE ( BOOK_ID, ACCOUNT_CODE, PERIOD, CURRENCY_CODE, BEGINNING_DEBIT, BEGINNING_CREDIT, PERIOD_DEBIT, PERIOD_CREDIT, ENDING_DEBIT, ENDING_CREDIT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{balanceData.bookId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{balanceData.accountCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{balanceData.period, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{balanceData.currencyCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{balanceData.beginningDebit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{balanceData.beginningCredit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{balanceData.periodDebit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{balanceData.periodCredit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{balanceData.endingDebit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{balanceData.endingCredit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT #{bookId} as BOOK_ID, #{accountCode} as ACCOUNT_CODE, #{period} as PERIOD, #{currencyCode} as CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN DIRECTION = 'DEBIT' AND VOUCHER_DATE < TO_DATE(SUBSTR(#{period}, 1, 4)||'-'||SUBSTR(#{period}, 6)||'-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) as BEGINNING_DEBIT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN DIRECTION = 'CREDIT' AND VOUCHER_DATE < TO_DATE(SUBSTR(#{period}, 1, 4)||'-'||SUBSTR(#{period}, 6)||'-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) as BEGINNING_CREDIT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN DIRECTION = 'DEBIT' AND VOUCHER_DATE >= TO_DATE(SUBSTR(#{period}, 1, 4)||'-'||SUBSTR(#{period}, 6)||'-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND VOUCHER_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(#{period}, 1, 4)||'-'||SUBSTR(#{period}, 6)||'-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 1) THEN AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) as PERIOD_DEBIT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN DIRECTION = 'CREDIT' AND VOUCHER_DATE >= TO_DATE(SUBSTR(#{period}, 1, 4)||'-'||SUBSTR(#{period}, 6)||'-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND VOUCHER_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(#{period}, 1, 4)||'-'||SUBSTR(#{period}, 6)||'-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 1) THEN AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) as PERIOD_CREDIT, SYSDATE as CALCULATE_TIME FROM TBL_VOUCHER_ENTRY WHERE BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND ACCOUNT_CODE = #{accountCode} AND CURRENCY_CODE = #{currencyCode} AND VOUCHER_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(#{period}, 1, 4)||'-'||SUBSTR(#{period}, 6)||'-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 1)

SELECT ADJUSTMENT_ID, BOOK_ID, ACCOUNT_CODE, ACCOUNT_NAME, PERIOD, CURRENCY_CODE, ADJUSTMENT_TYPE, ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT, ORIGINAL_BEGINNING_DEBIT, ORIGINAL_BEGINNING_CREDIT, ORIGINAL_PERIOD_DEBIT, ORIGINAL_PERIOD_CREDIT, NEW_BEGINNING_DEBIT, NEW_BEGINNING_CREDIT, NEW_PERIOD_DEBIT, NEW_PERIOD_CREDIT, ADJUSTMENT_REASON, ATTACHMENT_PATH, STATUS, APPLICANT_ID, APPLICANT_NAME, APPLY_TIME, APPROVER_ID, APPROVER_NAME, APPROVAL_TIME, APPROVAL_COMMENT, EXECUTOR_ID, EXECUTOR_NAME, EXECUTE_TIME, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME FROM TBL_BALANCE_ADJUSTMENT WHERE ADJUSTMENT_ID = #{adjustmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_BALANCE_ADJUSTMENT ( ADJUSTMENT_ID, BOOK_ID, ACCOUNT_CODE, ACCOUNT_NAME, PERIOD, CURRENCY_CODE, ADJUSTMENT_TYPE, ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT, ORIGINAL_BEGINNING_DEBIT, ORIGINAL_BEGINNING_CREDIT, ORIGINAL_PERIOD_DEBIT, ORIGINAL_PERIOD_CREDIT, NEW_BEGINNING_DEBIT, NEW_BEGINNING_CREDIT, NEW_PERIOD_DEBIT, NEW_PERIOD_CREDIT, ADJUSTMENT_REASON, ATTACHMENT_PATH, STATUS, APPLICANT_ID, APPLICANT_NAME, APPLY_TIME, REMARK, CREATE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{adjustmentData.adjustmentId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{adjustmentData.bookId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{adjustmentData.accountCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adjustmentData.accountName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adjustmentData.period, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adjustmentData.currencyCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adjustmentData.adjustmentType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adjustmentData.adjustmentAmount, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{adjustmentData.originalBeginningDebit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{adjustmentData.originalBeginningCredit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{adjustmentData.originalPeriodDebit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{adjustmentData.originalPeriodCredit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{adjustmentData.newBeginningDebit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{adjustmentData.newBeginningCredit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{adjustmentData.newPeriodDebit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{adjustmentData.newPeriodCredit, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{adjustmentData.adjustmentReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adjustmentData.attachmentPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adjustmentData.status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adjustmentData.applicantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{adjustmentData.applicantName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{adjustmentData.remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_BALANCE_ADJUSTMENT SET STATUS = #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APPROVER_ID = #{approverId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, APPROVER_NAME = #{approverName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APPROVAL_TIME = SYSDATE, APPROVAL_COMMENT = #{approvalComment, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE ADJUSTMENT_ID = #{adjustmentId}
